description:
Dosena, a city suffering from job difficulties, runs along the mountain behind it in frustration and encounters the natural Baekdudang River. Natural people really exist. On the mountain behind my house.

Seeing him like a mountain beast, Sena vowed not to climb the mountain again. After barely returning home and regaining her daily routine, Sena finds a familiar face. It's none other than... Wait, wasn't it "Natural Man"?
